description: This Java class represents a Recurrence information object, managing recurrence rules, exception rules, and recurrence dates for calendar events within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods for initialization, validation, iteration over recurrence rules and dates, and utility functions for creating recurrence instances.

classes.name: RecurrenceInfo
classes.description: This class encapsulates recurrence details such as rules, dates, and exception lists, providing methods to initialize, validate, and generate upcoming recurrence dates and rules.

methods.name: RecurrenceInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes RecurrenceInfo object with a GenericValue entity, validating entity type.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the recurrence rules and date lists based on the encapsulated entity data.

methods.name: getID
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the recurrence info.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the recurrence as a Date object.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start date as a long timestamp.

methods.name: getRecurrenceRuleIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the recurrence rules.

methods.name: getRecurrenceDateIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the recurrence dates.

methods.name: getExceptionRuleIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the exception rules.

methods.name: getExceptionDateIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the exception dates.

methods.name: getCurrentCount
methods.description: Returns the current recurrence count.

methods.name: incrementCurrentCount
methods.description: Increments the recurrence count and optionally stores it.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the recurrence and associated rules from persistent storage.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the first recurrence (start date).

methods.name: last
methods.description: Placeholder method to get the last recurrence time, currently unimplemented.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next recurrence time after now.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next recurrence time after a specified timestamp.

methods.name: isValidCurrent
methods.description: Checks if the current date/time is a valid recurrence.

methods.name: isValidCurrent
methods.description: Checks if a specific timestamp is a valid recurrence.

methods.name: primaryKey
methods.description: Returns the primary key of the recurrence info.

methods.name: makeInfo
methods.description: Static factory method to create new RecurrenceInfo instances with various parameters.

methods.name: toTemporalExpression
methods.description: Converts a RecurrenceInfo object into a TemporalExpression object for calendar processing.
